column2: [intro]
In my head, it’s a joyful mess,
I escape, lost in my thoughts, I confess.
Oh, what a fantastic feeling it brings,
To laugh in the midst of panic's swings.
I find it quite fascinating,
Everything happening is simply elating.
Let’s see the world in a different light,
With a hint of madness in sight.
At breakfast, I have my dreams on toast,
Enjoying them with a hot coffee, I boast.
Wacky ideas burst in my mind,
That’s my secret to staying on cloud nine.
I find it quite fascinating,
Everything happening is simply elating.
Let’s see the world in a different light,
With a hint of madness in sight.
[solo]
So come join me in this crazy dance,
Without worrying about the prying glance.
Life’s too short to be taken seriously,
Let our laughter ring out joyously.
[outro]
